purpose: Define machine-readable evidence for allow/deny/filter/mask/redact decisions, tied to exact policy, caller/context, source identity and data revision without exposing prohibited values.

topics.name: DWH Governance Decision Evidence
topics.purpose: Define machine-readable evidence for allow/deny/filter/mask/redact decisions, tied to exact policy, caller/context, source identity and data revision without exposing prohibited values.

semantics.identity_rule: Each machine-significant governance decision/evaluation has an explicit execution/evidence identity.
semantics.policy_rule: Decision references exact governance policy/binding version.
semantics.subject_rule: Caller/session/peer/context refs are explicit where applicable.
semantics.revision_rule: Decision may bind to exact source revision/snapshot/watermark where relevant.
semantics.redaction_rule: Decision evidence must not leak values that the decision itself denied.
semantics.accesscore_rule: DWH governance evidence is distinct from AccessCore authorization-decision evidence.
semantics.immutability_rule: Past decision evidence is append/history governed.

invariants.rule: DWH governance may restrict or project data according to exact schema/classification/scope policy but never creates AccessCore rights, semantic ownership or broader visibility than the underlying authorized source set.

hard_gates.condition: denial log leaks denied field value
DWH decision conflated with AccessCore result

references.purpose: Governance evidence remains separate from AC audit evidence.

prose.summary: Define machine-readable evidence for allow/deny/filter/mask/redact decisions, tied to exact policy, caller/context, source identity and data revision without exposing prohibited values.
